LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Void Dream
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Void Dream (T-02-99) is a drowsy three-eyed dream creature.\nUndisciplined workers anger it quickly; upon escaping, it swells into a shrieking rooster whose eerie crow drops nearby humans into deep nightmare coma until shaken awake by allies.
